llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Shell execution and curl/jq use are part of the advertised workflow and are disclosed in the skill metadata and setup text; this is a transparency note, not a Review-level concern for this small API wrapper.
[E1] expected: Sending the hotel query and API key to Camino is the core integration behavior and is disclosed; users should treat location and travel searches as data shared with Camino AI.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan reported clean, and artifact inspection found only SKILL.md plus a small hotel-finder shell script.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean and consistent with the inspected artifacts, but it was not used as the sole basis for the verdict.
llm.guidance: Install the specific hotel-finder skill rather than the whole Camino suite unless you have reviewed the other skills. Use a dedicated Camino API key if possible, keep it private, and avoid submitting confidential addresses, private itineraries, or sensitive travel plans unless you are comfortable sharing them with Camino AI.
llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward Camino hotel-search helper that sends your lodging search to Camino AI using your Camino API key.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: camino-hotel-finder
Version: 2.0.1

The camino-hotel-finder skill is a legitimate tool for searching lodging via the Camino AI API. The shell script (scripts/hotel-finder.sh) correctly handles input validation and URL encoding using jq, and makes authenticated GET requests to a hardcoded API endpoint (api.getcamino.ai). No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection was found.
